title: Portfolio Engine Target Architecture Audit and Roadmap

packages.name: @portfolio-engine/schema
packages.purpose: Shared schemas and validation contracts for config, content, context, and future registry data.

packages.name: @portfolio-engine/engine-core
packages.purpose: Config loading, route injection, virtual modules, override resolution, manifests, and generic runtime contracts.

packages.name: @portfolio-engine/editorial-theme
packages.purpose: The actual site theme: layouts, routes, components, styles, and public editorialTheme(...) API.

packages.name: @portfolio-engine/admin-tools
packages.purpose: Rendered admin/reviewer UI so nontechnical consumers can edit content, config, context, assets, and registry entries without looking at code.

packages.name: portfolio-engine-workflow-kit
packages.purpose: Local MCP server exposing tools to Claude/Copilot: inspect_site, plan_request, validate_plan, plan_upstream, patch_ledger.

mvpDefinition: MVP is the stable reusable backbone: schema + engine-core + editorial-theme + demo-site + CI/build/check + README/CONTRIBUTING + basic named overrides if documented. Consumer registry, admin-tools, workflow-kit, and advanced automation are post-MVP.
